title: Consume European Star Cross LZ streams
changes: Extend the existing observed LZ owner to serve two Star Cross source streams and decoded HLE output, preserving old stream indices and counters.
validation: Wine d2ksd6ci preserves 20 earlier streams and 147 other resources, rejects coherent edits, checks mirrors/boundaries, two original SWI and six DMA/CpuSet/CpuFastSet cases, and snapshot owner retention.
Wine lqmy00iv matches 480 frames with both source streams altered and one managed HLE call per stream. Wine m_69fwj8 creates, reuses and verifies the 149-file E293 dataset; all three servers drained.
limitations: One retained continuation does not establish asset identities, all callers and scenes, save ancestry or real BIOS behavior. Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
